name: code-yeongyu-pi-nested-agents-md
description: Nested AGENTS.md context injection for pi-mono coding-agent — ported from omo (oh-my-openagent). Walks up from any read file, injects nearby AGENTS.md into the tool result, with TUI status line, optional widget, /nested-agents toggle, --no-nested-agents flag, realpath-based root containment, code-point-safe truncation.
